fixedCheckerSettings.launcher: The trusted resolved Python >=3.8 executable launches a fixed stdlib harness with -I -B; no Node process runs inside the sandbox.

revisionUpdates.scope: Node 24 versus Homebrew Node 26 startup correction; actual local Codex sandbox and trusted Python only. No provider run, live database change, package build or owner acceptance.

limits: No live model stage or multi-stage workflow was run in this review.
Linux uses the same required CLI interface but needs actual CI proof before a supported workflow claim.
Native Windows fixed workflow checking is explicitly unavailable; local core support is separate.
Provider workspace-write is not OS-user read isolation; saved CLI authentication remains available to the CLI.
Command receipts report runtime observations, not independent correctness or human acceptance.
The workflow service must retain fixed oracle provenance and rehash candidate/oracle files after checking.
The macOS system Python launcher emits cache-denial diagnostics; checks still returned their observed 0/1 exit statuses.
